title: Fix launchable deployment package option
summary: Expose the Tauri preview launcher binary option in the Maintenance deployment-package UI and command contract so Create Deployment can produce a package-mode launchable bundle.
reason: The release build script already supports copying the compiled Tauri launcher with IncludeTauriPreviewBinary, but the WebView deployment flow did not send that option. Dry runs could complete while real deployment packages were missing the launcher needed for package-mode launch.
behavior_before: Plan Deployment and Create Deployment only exposed zip, verify, docs, tests, optional tools, personal config, and replacement options. The UI did not request IncludeTauriPreviewBinary, so a successful build could omit apps/desktop/tauri/mediapipeline-tauri-shell.exe.
behavior_after: Deployment Package now shows a default-on Include Tauri launcher option, sends include_tauri_preview_binary through dry-run and build commands, reports the option in release results, and keeps strict boolean validation on the local API payload.
manual_validation: focused unittest release package coverage - passed; 13 tests
npm run build from apps/desktop/tauri - passed; produced src-tauri/target/release/mediapipeline-tauri-shell.exe
ops/scripts/release/build.ps1 -DryRun -Verify -IncludeTauriPreviewBinary -KeepPersonalConfig to temp destination - passed; planned 12968 copies

ops/scripts/release/build.ps1 -Verify -IncludeTauriPreviewBinary -KeepPersonalConfig to temp destination - copied package and manifest with tauri_preview_binary_included=true, then failed existing release self-test gates unrelated to this change
packaged Test-TauriShell-Launch.ps1 -Mode Packaged reached copied exe but was blocked by existing debug mediapipeline-tauri-shell PID 49472 single-instance guard
rollback_plan: Revert the maintenance WebView checkbox/payload additions, remove include_tauri_preview_binary from the local API release command payload/defaults, and remove the focused regression assertions.
notes:
Expose IncludeTauriPreviewBinary in the WebView release-package flow so Create Deployment can produce a package-mode launchable bundle.
Pinned served Maintenance HTML/JS exposure for the Tauri launcher deployment option.
